scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --workspace @intouch/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @intouch/api" "npm run dev --workspace @intouch/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @intouch/api
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace @intouch/api && rimraf dist packages/shared/dist apps/web/.next
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @intouch/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @intouch/web
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @intouch/api && npm run build --workspace @intouch/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @intouch/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @intouch/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @intouch/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test --workspace @intouch/shared && npm test --workspace @intouch/api && npm test --workspace @intouch/web
scripts.test:web:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e --workspace @intouch/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run openapi:lint && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:web:e2e
